highlights: Source Control history now provides a readable commit graph, ref context, commit inspection, changed-file grouping, and file-history filtering
Signed Stable updates now download and install automatically when PARALITH is idle, with safe deferral around active work
fixes: Background update installation no longer depends on a user clicking the update notification after the application has bootstrapped to this updater-enabled build
Active Git mutations remain a hard safety boundary, while ordinary terminal and agent activity is deferred to a verified install-on-exit
databaseChanges: No database schema changes; schema version remains 46
requiredManualActions: No manual installer download is required. Users upgrading from Stable 0.4.21 must approve this one bootstrap update in the application because 0.4.21 cannot install a new binary without user action; later signed Stable updates install automatically when safe
